cards.card_text: Moses says the LORD became King in Jeshurun when the tribes of Israel came together.
cards.verse_text: So the LORD became King in Jeshurun when the leaders of the people gathered, when the tribes of Israel came together.

cards.card_text: Then Moses is done naming tribes and comes back to the LORD: there is none like the God of Jeshurun, who rides the heavens to your aid.
cards.verse_text: “There is none like the God of Jeshurun, who rides the heavens to your aid, and the clouds in His majesty.
